an7.45:1.1: “Bhikkhus, there are these seven prerequisites for concentration.
an7.45:1.3: Right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, and right mindfulness.
an7.45:1.4: Unification of mind with these seven factors as prerequisites is what is called noble right concentration ‘with its vital conditions’ and also ‘with its prerequisites’.”
